gen-dafont-college-gf-tiktok-sans: Flat, stencil-cut punch: College draws every stroke in one weight. TikTok Sans takes over below, its x-height nearly touching cap height, so extended paragraphs read in a smooth, spacious stream.
gen-dafont-college-gf-ubuntu-sans: College makes every curve as heavy as its straight stems, leaving big counters inside a tall lowercase. Ubuntu Sans flows on tubular strokes, its loops left gently unfinished.
gen-dafont-college-gf-vend-sans: College draws curves as stout as its stems, with wide counters in a tall lowercase. And Vend Sans runs a ruler-straight line with open terminals, so extended text moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-college-gf-yaldevi: Blunt and stencil-flat, College gives crossbars the same heft as its stems. But Yaldevi brings the real win, an outsized lowercase with an e that opens clearly rightward.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee reads friendly and approachable, its terminals stopping short of the stem. Conthrax above it stays wide-mouthed and geometric, so a longer run of text feels like following one thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-aldrich: Aldrich reads tight and modern, its x-height crowding the caps and its rounds looking cupped. Yet Conthrax matches it, wide-mouthed and geometric, so both seem to trace one thick thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-alexandria: Clean and geometric, Conthrax stamps every stroke at one measured width, while its lowercase a opens wide. Alexandria's tall body and short stems give it room to breathe beneath.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla brings wide, barely curled s curves and a short rise from midline to ascender. But Conthrax holds the pair together, its horizontal bars matching its upright stems in weight.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari keeps its letter mouths distinctly open and a tall middle zone. Conthrax, whose curves and straights share a single width, earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-gujarati: Approachable Anek Gujarati has a gaping c and lowercase rivaling the capitals. Conthrax up top draws every stroke without a hint of quill-style tapering, and that blunt uniformity is what sticks.
